name: KraKen's RNG [EPOCH 3]
desc:
After many hours of work and new updates, the game has changed a lot so feel free to rediscover it now! Change your dislike from the alpha version to a deserved like if you enjoy this new version.  This would really encourage us to continue on the right path! Also dont forget to join our Community Server (link below) to submit your ideas and / or new auras ! 

GAME TIPS
🥊 Ask Mr Bobo and do the starter glove quest for a permanent 10% Luck Boost!
➕ Expand your inventory by collecting Gold!
🍀 Use potions to boost up your Rolling Speed or Luck!

We sincerely apologies for the players who lost their data after the change of datastore from the alpha version to the new version of the game a month ago.
